definitions.explanation: the activity of removing unwanted plants (weeds) from a garden or field

examples.japanese: {草取|くさと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Weeding the garden makes my back hurt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{草取|くさと}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Weeding is hard work in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草取|くさと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I helped with weeding the field.

notes:
{草取|くさと}り refers to the chore of pulling weeds from a garden, yard, or field. A very common activity in Japanese households, especially during the warm months when weeds grow rapidly.

FORMS:
⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass/weeds) + ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (taking/removing, from ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {草取|くさと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do weeding
- ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草取|くさと}り: weeding the garden
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草取|くさと}り: weeding the field
- {草取|くさと}り{鎌|がま}: weeding sickle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {草取|くさと}り: weeding (standard)
- ⟦{草|くさ}むしり→草むしり：08195_kusamushiri⟧: weeding (more colloquial — from むしる, to pluck)
- ⟦{除草|じょそう}→除草：18648_josou⟧: weeding/herbicide application (formal/technical)
